Observation uses Astronomy Engine by Don Cross (MIT), OpenNGC by Mattia Verga
and contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0), and Natural Earth map geometry (public domain).
Their licenses are included alongside this notice.

OpenNGC: https://github.com/mattiaverga/OpenNGC
This research has made use of the NASA/IPAC Extragalactic Database (NED), operated
by the Jet Propulsion Laboratory, California Institute of Technology, under
contract with the National Aeronautics and Space Administration; the HyperLEDA
database (http://leda.univ-lyon1.fr); the SIMBAD database, operated at CDS,
Strasbourg, France; HEASARC catalogues; and Harold Corwin's NGC/IC positions/notes.
The unmodified OpenNGC catalogue data remains available under CC BY-SA 4.0.

Natural Earth: https://www.naturalearthdata.com/about/terms-of-use/
Astronomy Engine: https://github.com/cosinekitty/astronomy
Optional city lookup: GeoNames through Open-Meteo,
https://open-meteo.com/en/docs/geocoding-api (non-commercial service for personal use).

Optional hourly cloud forecasts: Open-Meteo (https://open-meteo.com/),
https://open-meteo.com/en/docs. API data are offered under CC BY 4.0:
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/ (https://open-meteo.com/en/licence).
Displayed source links identify Open-Meteo. Percentages are unmodified model
outputs; display rounding, selection by hour, and range summaries are performed
by AstroCapture. The non-commercial endpoint is used for personal use.
Weather test fixture: verbatim hourly slice retrieved 2026-10-12; source URL and
licence are retained in tests/unit/app/observation-weather.json.
